abstract: The electrophysiological properties of differentiated cells which were derived from teratocarcinoma OTT6050 in culture showed two different types of spike generation: (1) In the differentiated cells treated by retinoic acid, the action potential of cells involved Ca2+; (2) in the differentiated cells treated by both retinoic acid and nerve growth factor (NGF), the action potential of cells involved Na+ and CA2+. The results indicate that the effects of drugs appear to be important factors in the induction as well as in the regulation of cellular functions in the differentiated cells.
abstract_ja: テラトカルシノーマOTT6050の培養下で分化させた細胞について、電気生理学的特性を検討した。分化細胞の活動電位は2種類に分類された。(1)レチノイン酸処理した分化細胞では、活動電位にCa2+が関与していた。(2)レチノイン酸と神経成長因子(NGF)の両方で処理した分化細胞では、活動電位にNa+とCa2+が関与していた。これらの結果から、薬剤が分化細胞の細胞機能の誘導と制御において重要な因子となりうることが示された。
